thread:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a 95th pct token latency spike on /generate for the last 2 hours. Per-route KPIs show the median is fine but tail moved up ~30ms. :eyes:
liam: Can you paste an example req_id? we should link the token-level breakdown to a trace so we can see kernel selection + KV hit pattern per request.
maya: req_id=f7c3a9bb, trace=trace_01b9 (attached sample logs).
sophia: Quick profiling shows a kernel mismatch for some transformer ops when seq_len <= 64 — runtime picks the 'dense-simd' kernel which is slower for the current quantized packing. Seen in the kernel selector heatmap.
eloise: Also saw correlated KV cache misses for those req_ids. KV cache miss spikes line up with increased token tail latency. Might be prefix mismatch/eviction thrash.
liam: OK — proposal: add a stable correlation id on the token-metrics line and a trace_url field for our traces. Then Grafana panel can render token waterfall and the trace link. Example log line: 
```
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z req=f7c3a9bb trace=trace_01b9 span=decode.kernel_select kernel=dense-simd seq=32 kv_hit=false token_idx=14 latency_ms=12
```
maya: That log snippet is perfect. If token metrics had trace=... we could open the exact span in Jaeger/Tempo from the dashboard. Right now the token waterfall dashboard only shows aggregated buckets without direct trace links.
devex-bot: PR template created: rdu/instrumentation#412 — adds `trace_id` and `trace_url` to per-token metrics and a small UI affordance to jump to trace. :white_check_mark:
eloise: One more nuance — when the runtime falls back to the safe kernel path (due to quantization mismatch) latency for the first few tokens spikes, then the KV cache warms and it stabilizes. Need to capture kernel_version and fallback_reason in the span tags.
sophia: Agreed. Also adding `kernel_reason=quant-fallback` will help correlate with the kernel selector heatmap. I dumped some profiler lines: 
```
[profiler] req=f7c3a9bb stage=compile chosen_kernel=dense-simd alt_kernel=float32-gemm reason=quant-fallback compile_ms=3
```
liam: Implementation plan: (1) extend token emitter to include trace_id + trace_url + kernel tags, (2) update Grafana panel to show clickable trace link and token-level trace_id column, (3) add an A/B canary to Dedicated to validate overhead <1% CPU. I'll prototype the emitter change this week.
maya: Can you also add a per-route KPI (p95 token latency, token-miss-rate, kernel-fallback-rate) to the per-route dashboard? Product wants a single-pane view for regressions.
liam: Yep — will add panels and a link to the trace from each token waterfall row.
runtime-bot: Deploy succeeded: rdu/runtime@v3.14.2 — new token-emitter hooks enabled in canary cluster.
maya: Nice. Once the prototype lands, can we run the internal perf-run (1000 requests with mixed seq lengths) and compare old vs new token tail?
liam: On it. I'll post results here and include a sample trace link. :+1:
eloise: Thanks — if we capture `kv_eviction_reason` and `kernel_reason` in spans we can triage perf regressions much faster.
devex-bot: Noted — adding checklist items to PR: include trace_url, kernel_reason, kv_eviction_reason, and unit tests for emitter size.
maya: Sweet. Assigning follow-ups: @liam prototype emitter + dashboard, @eloise add eviction tagging, @sophia add kernel selector metrics. We'll reconvene after the canary run.
